title: OpenAI just solved math #shorts
description:
OpenAI just solved one of the most famous math problems in the world.

The Unit Distance Problem.

And it sounds super nerdy…

But this moment will go down as one of the most important breakthroughs in the future of humanity.

The interesting part about this story is not actually the problem itself.

It’s the way the AI model came up with the solution.

Until this point, AI math models were really good at one thing…brute force.

For problems that have millions of potential answers, AI is really good at rapidly testing them all.

Eventually finding the needle in a haystack that humans could never look through.

But the issue is…not all problems require brute force.

Sometimes, the only way to solve them is with out-of-the-box creativity.

Something that AI models just never could do.

That is…until now.

See the solution the AI model designed for this problem, was different than anything researchers have ever seen.
 
Essentially the model was able to think so far outside the box, it came up with an answer and chain of reasoning, humans would have never thought to try.

This is a massive breakthrough because for the first time ever, AI models have shown the ability for raw creativity.

That means they can come up with unique solutions to all sorts of science and math problems.

Cures for cancer, new materials, brand new physics…everything is on the table.

It feels small now, but this moment, in May 2026, will be marked in history as the day AI models first got creative.
